description: Read every citation in a piece of text (a brief, a judgment, an email) and resolve each to its provision, with its state on a date: in force or not, the law that last changed it, and the next change.

date.description: An in-force date, YYYY-MM-DD, or "today". Defaults to today.

max_results.description: At most this many distinct provisions are looked up (default 50, at most 100).

name: resolve_citations
title: Resolve citations
